name: robots/abrar2652__imitation-learning-aloha
title: Gym Aloha bimanual insertion (AlohaInsertion-v0)
intro: Gym Aloha bimanual insertion (AlohaInsertion-v0), adapted from abrar2652/imitation-learning-aloha. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
